test(markup): a handler's own style repaints the base style, once (rich-markup-zzc7)

The ordering bug was fixed by rich-markup-cg6 (#197), which paints the base
style once in the single render walk; this pins it. Fails against d10dd296e^.

refactor(widgets): an overlay is bounded through cropLines (rich-segment-1p2h) (#275)

* refactor(widgets): an overlay is bounded through cropLines (rich-segment-1p2h)

The overlay clip is the last survivor of Screen's split-then-unpadded-crop
hand-roll; it now composes splitLines(cropLines(...)) as Tree and Layout do.
Painter's fitRows keeps adjustLineLength: it bounds the rows of a frame
already shaped by its caller, one line at a time, which is that primitive's
own job — there is no stream there to crop.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(widgets): an overlay is offered the cells right of its column (rich-segment-1p2h)

paintOverlay rendered the overlay at the frame's full maxWidth and then
cropped it to maxWidth - at.x, so an overlay that fit itself to its offer
lost its right edge instead of wrapping inside it. The crop now only catches
an overlay that ignores what it was offered.
